page0.text:
This is just common sense, of course, but
once dinner is over, all that's left is to take a bath and go to bed.
There's no problem at all.
Really, it's totally normal. Nothing out of the ordinary about it.

page2.text:
"Um...Ms. Fujimura, I'd like to ask you something."
"Hm? What's up?"
"Well, um...you know..."

page3.text:
"Oh, right. You need a change of clothes. Hmm...I have school uniforms at home, and I can give you some of my regular clothes, too. Oh, or do you want to go home and get clothes?"
"...No, I think if I went, I wouldn't be able to come back. I'd rather not go home. My brother is, um..."

page4.text:
"Mm, don't worry about that. I just called your house and got permission from your grandfather. He said that he could rest easy knowing you're at your teacher's house, and thanked me for teaching you."
"O-oh, he did? Then, I can really stay over!?"
"Yup. So, about the clothes, you can use my pajamas. Hopefully you're okay with my underwear, too?"

page5.text:
"Ah... Um, yours might be...tight around the chest..."
"Mrgh. Oh, riiight. You've got a big bust.
...Gimme some of that."
"Kyaaah! W-what do you think you're doing!?"
"Ahahahahaha! Just kidding! ...But that is a problem. I don't have any bras in your size. Do you wear them to sleep?"

page6.text:
"Er...well, yes."
"Figures. A lot of bigger women do that. I bet it's uncomfortable, though! ...She says, all insensitive."
"...I-it is uncomfortable, but when that happens..."

page7.text:
"Aha, I see! Sure is nice to be young! Anyway, I'll gather up my younger-looking clothes by tomorrow morning. On that note, have a nice bath!"
"..."

page8.text:
"...Ngh."
Y-you didn't need to have that conversation in front of me, stupid Fuji-nee!
I'm a man! I'm trying not to think about it, but if you talk about it here, I'll be extra conscious, and I won't be able to look at Sakura the same way!

page9.text:
"Ohhh? What's wrong, Shirou? You're all red. Are you curious about what we were talking about?"
"...! H-hmph! I don't know what you're talking about! It was private, right? I didn't hear anything, and I don't care."

page10.text:
"Oh, okay. Then I'll share something interesting with you. Sakura's an 85E. Amazing, right? She's actually 13 centimeters bigger than last year.
I bet you've noticed, Shirou. How soft she looks lately, and how huggable she is..."

page11.text:
"You—!"
"M-Ms. Fujimura!
What are you saying!?"
"Eh? Huh? Oh, noooooo~"

page12.text:
Sakura counterattacks, taking Fuji-nee to the ground.
She's blushing bright red and furiously trying to cover Fuji-nee's mouth.

page13.text:
Sakura...
I understand why you'd want to silence Fuji-nee, but don't silence her basic life functions, too.

page14.text:
"Hah, hah, hah... Ahh, that surprised me, Sakura. You're more of a fighter than you look. I can't believe you just tried to suffocate your teacher."
"I can't imagine what you mean! I think you should act a little more sorry, Ms. Fujimura!"
Sakura turns away from Fuji-nee sulkily.
Then...
We end up making eye contact with each other.

page15.text:
"Oh."
"Oh, uh...the bath towels are in the bathroom."
"R-right! Off I go then, Senpai...!"

page16.text:
Sakura hurriedly turns to leave the living room.
"Hey—"
And, once again...
"Ow... I bumped my nose..."
I was about to warn her to watch her step.
Before I could, however, she ran smack dab into a pillar.

page17.text:
"Sakura, are you okay!?"
Was she panicking so bad she ran into a pillar before she even made it to the hallway?
"Yes, I'm fine... I'm okay, so I'll go take a bath nowww..."
Sakura disappears down the hall, her steps wavering.

page18.text:
"Whew."
I can finally breathe now that Sakura's in the bath.
If that tension had gone on much longer, I might've been the one to flee the living room.

page19.text:
"Hmmm?"
"What now? If you have something to say, say it, you delinquent teacher."

page20.text:
"Oh, nothing in particular. I was just thinking that Sakura's going to have a hard time too. You were kinda cute, getting all red and flustered.
Maybe it makes Sakura embarrassed to see you like that, too."

page21.text: "I wasn't r-red! Sakura is like family to me, you know! She's my kouhai who always cooks and eats with us! I wouldn't embarrass myself in front of her like that!"

page22.text:
"Uh-huh. So you don't want to embarrass yourself, hmm?"
"Of course not! She's Shinji's sister. I gotta take good care of my friend's sister."

page23.text:
"Huh? Oh, that's what you meant? I never thought you paid attention to that, but you actually care."
Fuji-nee heaves an exaggerated sigh.
This is...very unpleasant.

page24.text:
"I see many challenges on the horizon for you both."
"Mm? Where are you going?"
"To the changing room. I need to pick out some clothes for Sakura. Shirou, go get the guest bedroom ready for her. I'll bring some new sheets."
Fuji-nee just says whatever she wants and leaves me in the living room.

page25.text:
"...Hmph. Saber, I'm going to make up the guestroom, so wait here."
Saber nods wordlessly, and I leave the living room.

page26.text:
I make the bed and check the guestroom furnishings.
It's a different room from the one we initially set Saber up in, one that hasn't been used in a long time.
This one's better for Sakura, and it has a lock on the door.
Sakura's...well, a girl, so I figure she'll feel more comfortable if she can lock her door.

page27.text:
"...Not like I let Fuji-nee get to my head, or anything."
I lay the sheets out and pat them flat.
This bed has never been used.
As soon as I start thinking that Sakura's going to sleep on it tonight...
"I bet you've noticed, Shirou."
"Ergh."
Awful thoughts fill my mind.

page28.text:
"Th-that's stupid. After all this time, why would I..."
...But that goes without saying.
I've watched from right next to her as Sakura's grown more and more beautiful.
I'm happy for her, and I've been telling myself not to be conscious of it.
Sakura is Shinji's little sister, and she helps me out of a sense of guilt over the way her brother behaves.

page29.text:
"...It's already been a year and a half. It's not like I see her that way."
It all started with the accident that caused me to leave the kyudo club.
I hurt my shoulder at work, and there was some talk about the burn scars being an issue, so I figured it was a good time as any to quit the club.
...After that, I think it was Sakura who volunteered to start helping me out at home until my injuries healed.

page30.text:
She still looked younger back then, and struck me as a hard worker.
The first day, she waited in front of my house for me to come home, then stood there sullenly face to face for a while, until she finally said she wanted to help me. I think she was out there for two hours.

page31.text: "And now, that introvert's the rising star of the kyudo club. People sure can change."

page32.text:
Sakura's demeanor has brightened a lot, actually.
I first met her four years ago through Shinji, I think, when I went over to his house to play.

page33.text:
She was silent, and she had a habit of letting her hair cover her face.
...She still has that part of her, but Sakura back then looked positively downtrodden. She always had a glum look on her face, and would just stand around absently.
When I compare Sakura now to back then, I truly do feel happy for her.
I'm relieved that the depressed girl who was always staring at the ground is now someone who can laugh like she's genuinely enjoying life.

page34.text: "Don't you think about it sometimes? How soft and huggable she looks..."

page35.text:
...
...I don't really know, myself.
At the very least, I only saw Sakura as my kouhai until recently.
That image of her only started to crumble recently.
...When did it start, exactly? Maybe it happened long before I realized.
Or maybe...
We're so close that I never needed to notice.

page36.text:
"Damn it. Everything was going fine, so why..."
Why does the thought of Sakura sleeping over make my heart pound like this?
It's rude to Sakura.
I should hurry up and finish cleaning the room. Then I can let Sakura stay here.

page37.text:
"Huh? Saber, where's Sakura?"
"I don't know. She didn't come back here, so shouldn't she still be in the bath?"
"...? But it's already been an hour."

page38.text:
Maybe Sakura takes long baths.
She has to wash a lot of parts that I don't, so a quick shower might not be...

page39.text:
"Aaaargh stop, stop! Don't imagine it!"
I shake my head and sit down at the table.
Then, I brew some tea, and let the fragrant liquid soothe my throat.

page40.text:
"Whew..."
I purge myself of my fantasies and breathe deep.
Then...
"Shirou. Does Sakura have poor eyesight?"
What an odd question.

page41.text:
"? No, not really. Sakura has good vision.
I think she's 1.5 across both eyes."
"I see. I've noticed her running into walls and pillars frequently, so I presumed there might be some problem with her vision."

page42.text: "Oh, that. Well, I appreciate the concern, but Sakura's healthy. She's just a little clumsy lately because she's tired, but she's normally got her head on straighter than I do."

page43.text: "That's good to hear...but even so, if she is so tired she's running into walls, that is a problem. This is just my opinion, but I felt that her accident earlier was not due to fatigue, but because she misjudged where the pillar was."

page44.text:
...
Saber's opinion makes sense.
No matter how tired you are, you don't just start randomly walking into walls.

page45.text:
"..."
Speaking of Sakura, where is she?
If she's really in the bath, one hour is a pretty long time.
Right now...
